test_set.query: I am a small farmer owning 1.5 acres of agricultural land. Are there any direct cash benefit schemes for me to buy seeds and fertilizer?
ground_truth_claims: PM-KISAN provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months.
Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable landholding in their names are eligible.
The benefit is transferred directly to the Aadhaar-linked bank account (DBT).

test_set.query: My grandmother is 72 years old. Does Ayushman Bharat cover senior citizens for free hospital surgeries?
ground_truth_claims: Ayushman Bharat AB-PMJAY provides health insurance cover up to ₹5 Lakh per year for hospital care.
All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible for dedicated coverage regardless of income under Ayushman Vay Vandana Card.
Treatment is cashless and pre-existing diseases are covered from day one.

test_set.query: I am a street vendor with a small tea stall. Can I get a loan without any collateral or security?
ground_truth_claims: PM SVANidhi offers collateral-free working capital loan starting with ₹10,000 in the first tranche.
7% interest subsidy is credited upon timely quarterly repayment.
Vendors with a Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from local bodies are eligible.

test_set.query: My daughter is studying in 1st year B.Tech in an AICTE approved college. Is there any scholarship for girl students?
ground_truth_claims: AICTE Pragati Scholarship provides ₹50,000 per annum for girl students pursuing Degree or Diploma in technical institutions.
Family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum.
Maximum two girl children per family are eligible.

test_set.query: I want to open a long term savings account for my 5 year old daughter with tax exemption and high interest.
ground_truth_claims: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) can be opened for girls from birth up to 10 years of age.
Offers high sovereign-backed interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a.) with full tax exemption under Section 80C (EEE status).
Maturity is 21 years from account opening or upon marriage after age 18.

test_set.query: I work as a traditional carpenter. Is there any scheme providing free modern toolkits and skill training?
ground_truth_claims: PM Vishwakarma scheme provides ₹15,000 digital toolkit incentive grant for traditional craftspeople.
Provides daily stipend of ₹500 during skill training.
Offers collateral-free enterprise loan up to ₹3,00,000 at concessional 5% interest rate.

test_set.query: I want to install rooftop solar panels for my house to reduce my electricity bills to zero. How much subsidy does the government give?
ground_truth_claims: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana provides up to ₹78,000 direct central subsidy for rooftop solar systems.
Provides up to 300 units of free clean electricity per month.
Subsidy is directly transferred into the beneficiary bank account within 30 days.

test_set.query: I am a 22 year old recent graduate looking for corporate internship in top companies with monthly stipend.
ground_truth_claims: PM Internship Scheme provides 12 months internship in top 500 companies in India.
Provides monthly stipend of ₹5,000 along with a one-time grant of ₹6,000.
Youth aged 21 to 24 who are not in full-time employment or higher education are eligible.
